name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Focus on renovations that enhance functionality and broad appeal. Kitchen and bathroom updates, even minor ones, consistently yield high returns. Consider durable, low-maintenance materials for flooring and countertops. Adding a fresh coat of paint and improving curb appeal, such as landscaping or a new front door, can also significantly increase perceived value and attract quality tenants faster. Prioritize repairs that address structural issues or safety concerns before aesthetic upgrades to avoid costly problems down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, durable flooring, fresh paint, and improved curb appeal offer strong returns on investment for rental properties.
